587:                             tracing::info!("Received event from {did}");
588: 
589:                             let data = match ecdh_decrypt(&store.did_key, Some(&did), &event.data).and_then(|bytes| {
590:                                 serde_json::from_slice::<RequestResponsePayload>(&bytes).map_err(Error::from)
591:                             }) {
592:                                 Ok(pl) => pl,
593:                                 Err(e) => {
594:                                     if let Some(tx) = signal {
595:                                         let _ = tx.send(Err(e));
596:                                     }
597:                                     continue;
598:                                 }
599:                             };
600: 
601:                             tracing::debug!("Event from {did}: {:?}", data.event);
602: 
603:                             let result = store.check_request_message(&did, data, &mut signal).await.map_err(|e| {
604:                                 error!("Error processing message: {e}");
605:                                 e
606:                             });
607: 
608:                             if let Some(tx) = signal {
609:                                 let _ = tx.send(result);
610:                             }
611:                         }
612:                         // Used as the initial request/push
613:                         Ok(push) = discovery_rx.recv() => {
614:                             if let Err(e) = store.request(&push, RequestOption::Identity).await {
615:                                 error!("Error requesting identity: {e}");
616:                             }
617:                             if let Err(e) = store.push(&push).await {
618:                                 error!("Error pushing identity: {e}");
619:                             }
620:                         }
621:                         _ = tick.tick() => {
622:                             if auto_push {
623:                                 store.push_to_all().await;
624:                             }
625:                         }
626:                     }
627:                 }
628:             }
629:         });
630: 
631:         tokio::task::yield_now().await;
632:         Ok(store)
633:     }

640:     #[tracing::instrument(skip(self, data, signal))]
641:     async fn check_request_message(
642:         &mut self,
643:         _: &DID,
644:         data: RequestResponsePayload,
645:         signal: &mut Option<oneshot::Sender<Result<(), Error>>>,
646:     ) -> Result<(), Error> {
647:         if let Err(e) = data.verify() {
648:             match data.version {
649:                 RequestResponsePayloadVersion::V0 => {
650:                     tracing::warn!(
651:                         sender = %data.sender,
652:                         "Request received from a old implementation. Unable to verify signature."
653:                     );
654:                 }
655:                 _ => {
656:                     tracing::warn!(
657:                         sender = %data.sender,
658:                         error = %e,
659:                         "Unable to verify signature. Ignoring request"
660:                     );
661:                     return Ok(());
662:                 }
663:             };
664:         }
665: 
666:         if self
667:             .list_incoming_request()
668:             .await
669:             .unwrap_or_default()
670:             .contains(&data.sender)
671:             && data.event == Event::Request
672:         {
673:             warn!("Request exist locally. Skipping");
674:             return Ok(());
675:         }
676: 
677:         // Before we validate the request, we should check to see if the key is blocked
678:         // If it is, skip the request so we dont wait resources storing it.
679:         if self.is_blocked(&data.sender).await? && !matches!(data.event, Event::Block) {
680:             tracing::warn!("Received event from a blocked identity.");
681:             let payload = RequestResponsePayload::new(&self.did_key, Event::Block)?;
682: 
683:             return self
684:                 .broadcast_request(&data.sender, &payload, false, true)
685:                 .await;
686:         }
687: 
688:         match data.event {
689:             Event::Accept => {
690:                 let list = self.list_all_raw_request().await?;
691: 
692:                 let Some(item) = list
693:                     .iter()
694:                     .filter(|req| req.r#type() == RequestType::Outgoing)
695:                     .find(|req| data.sender.eq(req.did()))
696:                 else {
697:                     return Err(Error::from(anyhow::anyhow!(
698:                         "Unable to locate pending request. Already been accepted or rejected?"
699:                     )));
700:                 };
701: 
702:                 // Maybe just try the function instead and have it be a hard error?
703:                 if self.root_document.remove_request(item).await.is_err() {
704:                     return Err(Error::from(anyhow::anyhow!(
705:                         "Unable to locate pending request. Already been accepted or rejected?"
706:                     )));
707:                 }
708: 
709:                 self.add_friend(item.did()).await?;
710:             }
711:             Event::Request => {
712:                 if self.is_friend(&data.sender).await? {
713:                     tracing::debug!("Friend already exist. Remitting event");
714: 
715:                     let payload = RequestResponsePayload::new(&self.did_key, Event::Accept)?;
716: 
717:                     return self
718:                         .broadcast_request(&data.sender, &payload, false, false)
719:                         .await;
720:                 }
721: 
722:                 let list = self.list_all_raw_request().await?;
723: 
724:                 if let Some(inner_req) = list.iter().find(|request| {
725:                     request.r#type() == RequestType::Outgoing && data.sender.eq(request.did())
726:                 }) {
727:                     //Because there is also a corresponding outgoing request for the incoming request
728:                     //we can automatically add them
729:                     self.root_document.remove_request(inner_req).await?;
730:                     self.add_friend(inner_req.did()).await?;
731:                 } else {
732:                     let from = data.sender.clone();
733: 
734:                     let req = Request::In {
735:                         did: from.clone(),
736:                         date: data.created.unwrap_or_else(Utc::now),
737:                     };
738: 
739:                     self.root_document.add_request(&req).await?;
740: 
741:                     _ = self.export_root_document().await;
742: 
743:                     if self.identity_cache.get(&from).await.is_err() {
744:                         // Attempt to send identity request to peer if identity is not available locally.
745:                         if self.request(&from, RequestOption::Identity).await.is_err() {
746:                             if let Err(e) = self.lookup(LookupBy::DidKey(from.clone())).await {
747:                                 tracing::warn!("Failed to request identity from {from}: {e}.");
748:                             }
749:                         }
750:                     }
751: 
752:                     self.emit_event(MultiPassEventKind::FriendRequestReceived { from })
753:                         .await;
754:                 }
755: 
756:                 let payload = RequestResponsePayload::new(&self.did_key, Event::Response)?;
757: 
758:                 self.broadcast_request(&data.sender, &payload, false, false)
759:                     .await?;
760:             }
761:             Event::Reject => {
762:                 let list = self.list_all_raw_request().await?;
763:                 let internal_request = list
764:                     .iter()
765:                     .find(|request| {
766:                         request.r#type() == RequestType::Outgoing && data.sender.eq(request.did())
767:                     })
768:                     .ok_or(Error::FriendRequestDoesntExist)?;
769: 
770:                 self.root_document.remove_request(internal_request).await?;
771: 
772:                 _ = self.export_root_document().await;
773: 
774:                 self.emit_event(MultiPassEventKind::OutgoingFriendRequestRejected {
775:                     did: data.sender,
776:                 })
777:                 .await;
778:             }
779:             Event::Remove => {
780:                 if self.is_friend(&data.sender).await? {
781:                     self.remove_friend(&data.sender, false).await?;
782:                 }
783:             }
784:             Event::Retract => {
785:                 let list = self.list_all_raw_request().await?;
786:                 let internal_request = list
787:                     .iter()
788:                     .find(|request| {
789:                         request.r#type() == RequestType::Incoming && data.sender.eq(request.did())
790:                     })
791:                     .ok_or(Error::FriendRequestDoesntExist)?;
792: 
793:                 self.root_document.remove_request(internal_request).await?;
794: 
795:                 _ = self.export_root_document().await;
796: 
797:                 self.emit_event(MultiPassEventKind::IncomingFriendRequestClosed {
798:                     did: data.sender,
799:                 })
800:                 .await;
801:             }
802:             Event::Block => {
803:                 let sender = data.sender;
804: 
805:                 if self.has_request_from(&sender).await? {
806:                     self.emit_event(MultiPassEventKind::IncomingFriendRequestClosed {
807:                         did: sender.clone(),
808:                     })
809:                     .await;
810:                 } else if self.sent_friend_request_to(&sender).await? {
811:                     self.emit_event(MultiPassEventKind::OutgoingFriendRequestRejected {
812:                         did: sender.clone(),
813:                     })
814:                     .await;
815:                 }
816: 
817:                 let list = self.list_all_raw_request().await?;
818:                 for req in list.iter().filter(|req| req.did().eq(&sender)) {
819:                     self.root_document.remove_request(req).await?;
820:                 }
821: 
822:                 if self.is_friend(&sender).await? {
823:                     self.remove_friend(&sender, false).await?;
824:                 }
825: 
826:                 let completed = self.root_document.add_block_by(&sender).await.is_ok();
827:                 if completed {
828:                     _ = self.export_root_document().await;
829: 
830:                     let _ = futures::join!(
831:                         self.push(&sender),
832:                         self.request(&sender, RequestOption::Identity)
833:                     );
834: 
835:                     self.emit_event(MultiPassEventKind::BlockedBy { did: sender })
836:                         .await;
837:                 }
838: 
839:                 if let Some(tx) = signal.take() {
840:                     tracing::debug!("Signaling broadcast of response...");
841:                     let _ = tx.send(Err(Error::BlockedByUser));
842:                 }
843:             }
844:             Event::Unblock => {
845:                 let sender = data.sender;
846:                 let completed = self.root_document.remove_block_by(&sender).await.is_ok();
847: 
848:                 if completed {
849:                     _ = self.export_root_document().await;
850: 
851:                     let _ = futures::join!(
852:                         self.push(&sender),
853:                         self.request(&sender, RequestOption::Identity)
854:                     );
855: 
856:                     self.emit_event(MultiPassEventKind::UnblockedBy { did: sender })
857:                         .await;
858:                 }
859:             }
860:             Event::Response => {
861:                 if let Some(tx) = signal.take() {
862:                     tracing::debug!("Signaling broadcast of response...");
863:                     let _ = tx.send(Ok(()));
864:                 }
865:             }
866:         };
867: 
868:         Ok(())
869:     }

1137:     async fn process_message(
1138:         &mut self,
1139:         in_did: &DID,
1140:         event: IdentityEvent,
1141:         exclude_images: bool,
1142:     ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
1143:         match event {
1144:             IdentityEvent::Request { option } => match option {
1145:                 RequestOption::Identity => self.push(in_did).await?,
1146:                 RequestOption::Image { banner, picture } => {
1147:                     if let Some(cid) = banner {
1148:                         self.push_profile_banner(in_did, cid).await?;
1149:                     }
1150:                     if let Some(cid) = picture {
1151:                         self.push_profile_picture(in_did, cid).await?;
1152:                     }
1153:                 }
1154:             },
1155:             IdentityEvent::Receive {
1156:                 option: ResponseOption::Identity { identity },
1157:             } => {
1158:                 //TODO: Validate public key against peer that sent it
1159:                 // let _pk = did_to_libp2p_pub(&raw_object.did)?;
1160: 
1161:                 //TODO: Remove upon offline implementation
1162:                 anyhow::ensure!(identity.did.eq(in_did), "Payload doesnt match identity");
1163: 
1164:                 // Validate after making sure the identity did matches the payload
1165:                 identity.verify()?;
1166: 
1167:                 if let Ok(own_id) = self.own_identity().await {
1168:                     if own_id.did_key() == identity.did {
1169:                         tracing::warn!(did = %identity.did, "Cannot accept own identity");
1170:                         return Ok(());
1171:                     }
1172:                 }
1173: 
1174:                 if !exclude_images && !self.discovery.contains(&identity.did).await {
1175:                     if let Err(e) = self.discovery.insert(&identity.did).await {
1176:                         tracing::warn!("Error inserting into discovery service: {e}");
1177:                     }
1178:                 }
1179: 
1180:                 let previous_identity = self.identity_cache.get(&identity.did).await.ok();
1181: 
1182:                 self.identity_cache.insert(&identity).await?;
1183: 
1184:                 match previous_identity {
1185:                     Some(document) => {
1186:                         if document.different(&identity) {
1187:                             tracing::info!(%identity.did, "Updating local cache");
1188: 
1189:                             let document_did = identity.did.clone();
1190: 
1191:                             let mut emit = false;
1192: 
1193:                             if matches!(
1194:                                 self.config.store_setting.update_events,
1195:                                 UpdateEvents::Enabled
1196:                             ) {
1197:                                 emit = true;
1198:                             } else if matches!(
1199:                                 self.config.store_setting.update_events,
1200:                                 UpdateEvents::FriendsOnly | UpdateEvents::EmitFriendsOnly
1201:                             ) && self.is_friend(&document_did).await.unwrap_or_default()
1202:                             {
1203:                                 emit = true;
1204:                             }
1205: 
1206:                             if emit {
1207:                                 tracing::trace!("Emitting identity update event");
1208:                                 self.emit_event(MultiPassEventKind::IdentityUpdate {
1209:                                     did: document.did.clone(),

1936:     pub async fn lookup(&self, lookup: LookupBy) -> Result<Vec<Identity>, Error> {
1937:         let own_did = self
1938:             .own_identity()
1939:             .await
1940:             .map(|identity| identity.did_key())
1941:             .map_err(|_| Error::OtherWithContext("Identity store may not be initialized".into()))?;
1942: 
1943:         let cache = self.identity_cache.list().await?;
1944: 
1945:         let mut idents_docs = match &lookup {
1946:             //Note: If this returns more than one identity, then its likely due to frontend cache not clearing out.
1947:             //TODO: Maybe move cache into the backend to serve as a secondary cache
1948:             LookupBy::DidKey(pubkey) => {
1949:                 //Maybe we should omit our own key here?
1950:                 if *pubkey == own_did {
1951:                     return self.own_identity().await.map(|i| vec![i]);
1952:                 }
1953: 
1954:                 if !self.discovery.contains(pubkey).await {
1955:                     self.discovery.insert(pubkey).await?;
1956:                 }
1957:                 cache
1958:                     .filter(|ident| {
1959:                         let ident = ident.clone();
1960:                         async move { ident.did == *pubkey }
1961:                     })
1962:                     .collect::<HashSet<_>>()
1963:                     .await
1964:             }
1965:             LookupBy::DidKeys(list) => {
1966:                 for pubkey in list {
1967:                     if !pubkey.eq(&own_did) && !self.discovery.contains(pubkey).await {
1968:                         if let Err(e) = self.discovery.insert(pubkey).await {
1969:                             tracing::error!("Error inserting {pubkey} into discovery: {e}")
1970:                         }
1971:                     }
1972:                 }
1973: 
1974:                 let mut prestream = SelectAll::new();
1975: 
1976:                 if list.contains(&own_did) {
1977:                     if let Ok(own_identity) = self.own_identity_document().await {
1978:                         prestream.push(futures::stream::iter(vec![own_identity]));
1979:                     }
1980:                 }
1981: 
1982:                 cache
1983:                     .filter(|id| {
1984:                         let id = id.clone();
1985:                         async move { list.contains(&id.did) }
1986:                     })
1987:                     .chain(prestream.boxed())
1988:                     .collect::<HashSet<_>>()
1989:                     .await
1990:             }
1991:             LookupBy::Username(username) if username.contains('#') => {
1992:                 let split_data = username.split('#').collect::<Vec<&str>>();
1993: 
1994:                 if split_data.len() != 2 {
1995:                     cache
1996:                         .filter(|ident| {
1997:                             let ident = ident.clone();
1998:                             async move {
1999:                                 ident
2000:                                     .username
2001:                                     .to_lowercase()
2002:                                     .contains(&username.to_lowercase())
2003:                             }
2004:                         })
2005:                         .collect::<HashSet<_>>()
2006:                         .await
2007:                 } else {
2008:                     match (
2009:                         split_data.first().map(|s| s.to_lowercase()),
2010:                         split_data.last().map(|s| s.to_lowercase()),
2011:                     ) {
2012:                         (Some(name), Some(code)) => {
2013:                             cache
2014:                                 .filter(|ident| {
2015:                                     let ident = ident.clone();
2016:                                     let name = name.clone();
2017:                                     let code = code.clone();
2018:                                     async move {
2019:                                         ident.username.to_lowercase().eq(&name)
2020:                                             && String::from_utf8_lossy(&ident.short_id)
2021:                                                 .to_lowercase()
2022:                                                 .eq(&code)
2023:                                     }
2024:                                 })
2025:                                 .collect::<HashSet<_>>()
2026:                                 .await
2027:                         }
2028:                         _ => HashSet::new(),
2029:                     }
2030:                 }
2031:             }
2032:             LookupBy::Username(username) => {
2033:                 let username = username.to_lowercase();
2034:                 cache
2035:                     .filter(|ident| {
2036:                         let ident = ident.clone();
2037:                         let username = username.clone();
2038:                         async move { ident.username.to_lowercase().contains(&username) }
2039:                     })
2040:                     .collect::<HashSet<_>>()
2041:                     .await
2042:             }
2043:             LookupBy::ShortId(id) => {
2044:                 cache
2045:                     .filter(|ident| {
2046:                         let ident = ident.clone();
2047:                         let id = id.clone();
2048:                         async move { String::from_utf8_lossy(&ident.short_id).eq(&id) }
2049:                     })
2050:                     .collect::<HashSet<_>>()
2051:                     .await
2052:             }
2053:         };
2054:         if idents_docs.is_empty() {
2055:             let kind = match lookup {
2056:                 LookupBy::DidKey(did) => shuttle::identity::protocol::Lookup::PublicKey { did },
2057:                 LookupBy::DidKeys(list) => {
2058:                     shuttle::identity::protocol::Lookup::PublicKeys { dids: list }
2059:                 }
2060:                 LookupBy::Username(username) => {
2061:                     shuttle::identity::protocol::Lookup::Username { username, count: 0 }
2062:                 }
2063:                 LookupBy::ShortId(short_id) => shuttle::identity::protocol::Lookup::ShortId {
2064:                     short_id: short_id.try_into()?,
2065:                 },
2066:             };
2067:             if let DiscoveryConfig::Shuttle { addresses } = self.discovery.discovery_config() {
2068:                 for peer_id in addresses.keys().copied() {
2069:                     let (tx, rx) = futures::channel::oneshot::channel();
2070:                     let _ = self
2071:                         .identity_command
2072:                         .clone()
2073:                         .send(shuttle::identity::client::IdentityCommand::Lookup {
2074:                             peer_id,
2075:                             kind: kind.clone(),
2076:                             response: tx,
2077:                         })
2078:                         .await;
2079: 
2080:                     match tokio::time::timeout(SHUTTLE_TIMEOUT, rx).await {
2081:                         Ok(Ok(Ok(list))) => {
2082:                             for ident in &list {
2083:                                 let ident = ident.clone().into();
2084:                                 _ = self.identity_cache.insert(&ident).await;
2085: 
2086:                                 if self.discovery.contains(&ident.did).await {
2087:                                     continue;
2088:                                 }
2089:                                 let _ = self.discovery.insert(&ident.did).await;
2090:                             }
2091: 
2092:                             idents_docs.extend(list.iter().cloned().map(|doc| doc.into()));
2093:                             break;
2094:                         }
2095:                         Ok(Ok(Err(e))) => {
2096:                             error!("Error registering identity to {peer_id}: {e}");
2097:                             break;
2098:                         }
2099:                         Ok(Err(Canceled)) => {
2100:                             error!("Channel been unexpectedly closed for {peer_id}");
2101:                             continue;
2102:                         }
2103:                         Err(_) => {
2104:                             error!("Request timed out for {peer_id}");
2105:                             continue;
2106:                         }
2107:                     }
2108:                 }
2109:             }
2110:         }
2111: 
2112:         let list = idents_docs
2113:             .iter()
2114:             .filter_map(|doc| doc.resolve().ok())
2115:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
2116: 
2117:         Ok(list)
2118:     }

2383:         let local_public_key = (*self.did_key).clone();
2384: 
2385:         if local_public_key.eq(pubkey) {
2386:             return Err(Error::CannotSendSelfFriendRequest);
2387:         }
2388: 
2389:         if self.is_friend(pubkey).await? {
2390:             return Err(Error::FriendExist);
2391:         }
2392: 
2393:         if self.is_blocked_by(pubkey).await? {
2394:             return Err(Error::BlockedByUser);

2396: 
2397:         if self.is_blocked(pubkey).await? {
2398:             return Err(Error::PublicKeyIsBlocked);
2399:         }
2400: 
2401:         if self.has_request_from(pubkey).await? {
2402:             return self.accept_request(pubkey).await;
2403:         }
2404: 
2405:         let list = self.list_all_raw_request().await?;
2406: 
2407:         if list
2408:             .iter()
2409:             .any(|request| request.r#type() == RequestType::Outgoing && request.did().eq(pubkey))
2410:         {
2411:             // since the request has already been sent, we should not be sending it again
2412:             return Err(Error::FriendRequestExist);
2413:         }
2414: 
2415:         let payload = RequestResponsePayload::new(&self.did_key, Event::Request)?;
2416: 
2417:         self.broadcast_request(pubkey, &payload, true, true).await
2418:     }

2422:         let local_public_key = (*self.did_key).clone();
2423: 
2424:         if local_public_key.eq(pubkey) {
2425:             return Err(Error::CannotAcceptSelfAsFriend);
2426:         }
2427: 
2428:         if !self.has_request_from(pubkey).await? {
2429:             return Err(Error::FriendRequestDoesntExist);
2430:         }
2431: 
2432:         let list = self.list_all_raw_request().await?;
2433: 
2434:         let internal_request = list
2435:             .iter()
2436:             .find(|request| request.r#type() == RequestType::Incoming && request.did().eq(pubkey))
2437:             .ok_or(Error::CannotFindFriendRequest)?;
2438: 
2439:         if self.is_friend(pubkey).await? {
2440:             warn!("Already friends. Removing request");
2441: 
2442:             self.root_document.remove_request(internal_request).await?;
2443: 
2444:             _ = self.export_root_document().await;
2445: 
2446:             return Ok(());
2447:         }
2448:

7: Warp can run as a single binary, providing an interface into the core technologies that run

The goal is to remove cleanup logic that relies on `Arc::strong_count` checks inside `Drop` implementations. The Rust documentation warns that the strong count can change at any time (including between calling the method and acting on the result), which makes this pattern unreliable. Two threads can easily both observe a count of 2 when they expect 1, causing cleanup to be skipped. This affects several background task wrapper types and the `Tesseract` key store.

    For the task wrapper types, the current pattern stores an `Arc<tokio::task::JoinHandle<()>>` and aborts the task in `Drop` when the strong count is 1. We need to replace this with a cancellation token approach: store a `DropGuard` from `tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken` (wrapped in `Arc`), create the token alongside the task, and race the cancelled signal against the task's own completion using `tokio::select!`.

    For `Tesseract`, the current `Drop` impl checks the strong count of `enc_pass` to decide whether to call `lock()`. Remove this `Drop` impl entirely. Also consolidate the many `Arc` fields into a single `Arc<TesseractInner>` struct containing all of them, allowing `Clone` to be derived instead of hand-written.

    As an additional cleanup, rename the `start` methods on the background task types to `run`, since these methods are the task code itself rather than merely "starting" the task.

    Affected files:
    - `extensions/warp-ipfs/src/store/document/cache.rs`
    - `extensions/warp-ipfs/src/store/document/conversation.rs`
    - `extensions/warp-ipfs/src/store/document/root.rs`
    - `extensions/warp-ipfs/src/store/event_subscription.rs`
    - `tools/shuttle/src/store/identity.rs`
    - `tools/shuttle/src/store/root.rs`
    - `warp/src/tesseract/mod.rs`

In `extensions/warp-ipfs/src/store/document/cache.rs`, `extensions/warp-ipfs/src/store/document/conversation.rs`, `extensions/warp-ipfs/src/store/document/root.rs`, `extensions/warp-ipfs/src/store/event_subscription.rs`, `tools/shuttle/src/store/identity.rs`, and `tools/shuttle/src/store/root.rs`:

269: impl IdentityStorageTask {
270:     pub async fn start(&mut self) {
271:         while let Some(command) = self.rx.next().await {
272:             match command {
273:                 IdentityStorageCommand::Register { document, response } => {
274:                     _ = response.send(self.register(document).await);
275:                 }
276:                 IdentityStorageCommand::Update { document, response } => {
277:                     _ = response.send(self.update(document).await);
278:                 }
279:                 IdentityStorageCommand::Lookup { kind, response } => {
280:                     _ = response.send(self.lookup(kind).await);
281:                 }
282:                 IdentityStorageCommand::Contains { did, response } => {
283:                     _ = response.send(self.contains(did).await);
284:                 }
285:                 IdentityStorageCommand::DeliverRequest {
286:                     to,
287:                     request,
288:                     response,
289:                 } => _ = response.send(self.deliver_request(to, request).await),
290:                 IdentityStorageCommand::FetchAll { did, response } => {
291:                     _ = response.send(self.fetch_requests(did).await)
292:                 }
293:                 IdentityStorageCommand::StorePackage { did, pkg, response } => {
294:                     _ = response.send(self.store_package(did, pkg).await)
295:                 }
296:                 IdentityStorageCommand::GetPackage { did, response } => {
297:                     _ = response.send(self.get_package(did).await)
298:                 }
299:                 IdentityStorageCommand::List { response } => {
300:                     _ = response.send(Ok(self.list().await.collect::<Vec<_>>().await))
301:                 }
302:             }
303:         }
304:     }

306:     async fn contains(&self, did: DID) -> bool {

324:     async fn register(&mut self, document: IdentityDocument) -> Result<(), Error> {
325:         document.verify()?;
326: 
327:         let mut list: HashMap<String, Cid> = match self.list {
328:             Some(cid) => self
329:                 .ipfs
330:                 .get_dag(cid)
331:                 .local()
332:                 .deserialized()
333:                 .await
334:                 .unwrap_or_default(),
335:             None => HashMap::new(),
336:         };
337: 
338:         let did_str = document.did.to_string();
339: 
340:         if list.contains_key(&did_str) {
341:             return Err(Error::IdentityExist);
342:         }
343: 
344:         let cid = self
345:             .ipfs
346:             .dag()
347:             .put()
348:             .serialize(document.clone())?
349:             .pin(false)
350:             .await?;
351: 
352:         list.insert(did_str, cid);
353: 
354:         let cid = self.ipfs.dag().put().serialize(list)?.pin(false).await?;
355: 
356:         let old_cid = self.list.replace(cid);
357: 
358:         if let Some(old_cid) = old_cid {
359:             if old_cid != cid {
360:                 if self.ipfs.is_pinned(&old_cid).await.unwrap_or_default() {
361:                     _ = self.ipfs.remove_pin(&old_cid).await;
362:                 }
363: 
364:                 tracing::info!(cid = %old_cid, "removing block(s)");
365:                 let remove_blocks = self
366:                     .ipfs
367:                     .remove_block(old_cid, false)
368:                     .await
369:                     .unwrap_or_default();
370:                 tracing::info!(cid = %old_cid, blocks_removed = remove_blocks.len(), "blocks removed");
371:             }
372:         }
373: 
374:         self.root.set_identity_list(cid).await?;
375: 
376:         Ok(())
377:     }

379:     async fn store_package(&mut self, did: DID, package: Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), Error> {
380:         if !self.contains(did.clone()).await {
381:             return Err(Error::IdentityDoesntExist);
382:         }
383: 
384:         let mut list: HashMap<String, Cid> = match self.packages {
385:             Some(cid) => self
386:                 .ipfs
387:                 .get_dag(cid)
388:                 .local()
389:                 .deserialized()
390:                 .await
391:                 .unwrap_or_default(),
392:             None => HashMap::new(),
393:         };
394: 
395:         let pkg_path = self
396:             .ipfs
397:             .add_unixfs(
398:                 futures::stream::once(async move { Ok::<_, std::io::Error>(package) }).boxed(),
399:             )
400:             .await?;
401: 
402:         let pkg_cid = pkg_path.root().cid().copied().expect("Cid available");
403: 
404:         list.insert(did.to_string(), pkg_cid);
405: 
406:         let cid = self.ipfs.dag().put().pin(true).serialize(list)?.await?;
407: 
408:         let old_cid = self.packages.replace(cid);
409:         if let Some(old_cid) = old_cid {
410:             if old_cid != cid {
411:                 if self.ipfs.is_pinned(&old_cid).await.unwrap_or_default() {
412:                     tracing::debug!(cid = %old_cid, "unpinning identity package block");
413:                     _ = self.ipfs.remove_pin(&old_cid).recursive().await;
414:                 }
415: 
416:                 tracing::info!(cid = %old_cid, "removing block(s)");
417:                 let remove_blocks = self
418:                     .ipfs
419:                     .remove_block(old_cid, true)
420:                     .await
421:                     .unwrap_or_default();
422:                 tracing::info!(cid = %old_cid, blocks_removed = remove_blocks.len(), "blocks removed");
423:             }
424:         }
425:         self.root.set_package(cid).await?;
426: 
427:         Ok(())
428:     }

518:         if let Some(old_cid) = old_cid {

570:         let list_stream = self.list().await;
571: 
572:         let list = match kind {

577:                     .await;
578: 
579:                 tracing::info!(did = %did, found = internal_document.iter().any(|document| document.did == did));
580: 
581:                 internal_document
582:             }
583:             Lookup::PublicKeys { dids } => {
584:                 tracing::trace!(list_size = dids.len());
585: 
586:                 let list = list_stream
587:                     .filter(|document| futures::future::ready(dids.contains(&document.did)))
588:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>()
589:                     .await;
590: 
591:                 tracing::info!(list_size = list.len(), "Found");
592: 
593:                 list
594:             }
595:             Lookup::Username { username, .. } if username.contains('#') => {
596:                 //TODO: Score against invalid username scheme
597:                 let split_data = username.split('#').collect::<Vec<&str>>();
598: 
599:                 let list = if split_data.len() != 2 {
600:                     list_stream
601:                         .filter(|document| {
602:                             futures::future::ready(
603:                                 document
604:                                     .username
605:                                     .to_lowercase()
606:                                     .eq(&username.to_lowercase()),
607:                             )
608:                         })
609:                         .collect::<Vec<_>>()
610:                         .await
611:                 } else {
612:                     match (
613:                         split_data.first().map(|s| s.to_lowercase()),
614:                         split_data.last().map(|s| s.to_lowercase()),
615:                     ) {
616:                         (Some(name), Some(code)) => {
617:                             list_stream
618:                                 .filter(|ident| {
619:                                     futures::future::ready(
620:                                         ident.username.to_lowercase().eq(&name)
621:                                             && String::from_utf8_lossy(&ident.short_id)
622:                                                 .to_lowercase()
623:                                                 .eq(&code),
624:                                     )
625:                                 })
626:                                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
627:                                 .await
628:                         }
629:                         _ => vec![],
630:                     }
631:                 };
632: 
633:                 tracing::info!(list_size = list.len(), "Found identities");
634: 
635:                 list
636:             }
637:             Lookup::Username { username, .. } => {
638:                 //TODO: Score against invalid username scheme
639:                 let list = list_stream
640:                     .filter(|document| {
641:                         futures::future::ready(
642:                             document
643:                                 .username
644:                                 .to_lowercase()
645:                                 .contains(&username.to_lowercase()),
646:                         )
647:                     })
648:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>()
649:                     .await;
650: 
651:                 tracing::info!(list_size = list.len(), "Found identities");
652: 
653:                 list
654:             }
655:             Lookup::ShortId { short_id } => {
656:                 list_stream
657:                     .filter(|document| {
658:                         futures::future::ready(document.short_id.eq(short_id.as_ref()))
659:                     })
660:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>()
661:                     .await
662:             } // Lookup::Locate { .. } => unreachable!(),
663:         };
664: 
665:         Ok(list)

668:     async fn fetch_requests(&mut self, did: DID) -> Result<(Vec<RequestPayload>, usize), Error> {
669:         let key_str = did.to_string();
670:         let mut list: HashMap<String, Cid> = match self.mailbox {
671:             Some(cid) => self
672:                 .ipfs
673:                 .get_dag(cid)
674:                 .local()
675:                 .deserialized()
676:                 .await
677:                 .unwrap_or_default(),
678:             None => return Ok((Vec::new(), 0)),
679:         };
680: 
681:         let mut mailbox = match list.get(&key_str) {
682:             Some(cid) => self
683:                 .ipfs
684:                 .get_dag(*cid)
685:                 .local()
686:                 .deserialized::<Vec<RequestPayload>>()
687:                 .await
688:                 .unwrap_or_default(),
689:             None => return Ok((Vec::new(), 0)),
690:         };
691: 
692:         if mailbox.is_empty() {
693:             return Ok((Vec::new(), 0));
694:         }
695: 
696:         mailbox.sort_by(|a, b| b.cmp(a));
697: 
698:         let mut requests = vec![];
699: 
700:         let mut counter = 0;
701: 
702:         while let Some(req) = mailbox.pop() {
703:             if counter > 50 {
704:                 break;
705:             }
706:             requests.push(req);
707:             counter += 1;
708:         }
709: 
710:         let remaining = mailbox.len();
711: 
712:         let cid = self.ipfs.dag().put().serialize(mailbox)?.await?;
713: 
714:         list.insert(key_str, cid);
715: 
716:         let cid = self.ipfs.dag().put().serialize(list)?.pin(true).await?;
717: 
718:         let old_cid = self.mailbox.replace(cid);
719: 
720:         if let Some(old_cid) = old_cid {
721:             if old_cid != cid {
722:                 if self.ipfs.is_pinned(&old_cid).await.unwrap_or_default() {
723:                     tracing::debug!(cid = %old_cid, "unpinning identity mailbox block");
724:                     _ = self.ipfs.remove_pin(&old_cid).recursive().await;
725:                 }
726: 
727:                 tracing::info!(cid = %old_cid, "removing block(s)");
728:                 let remove_blocks = self
729:                     .ipfs
730:                     .remove_block(old_cid, true)
731:                     .await
732:                     .unwrap_or_default();
733:                 tracing::info!(cid = %old_cid, blocks_removed = remove_blocks.len(), "blocks removed");
734:             }
735:         }
736: 
737:         self.root.set_mailbox(cid).await?;
738: 
739:         Ok((requests, remaining))
740:     }

742:     async fn deliver_request(&mut self, to: DID, request: RequestPayload) -> Result<(), Error> {

272:     /// Import and encrypt a hashmap into tesseract
273:     ///
274:     /// # Example
275:     ///
276:     /// ```
277:     /// let map = std::collections::HashMap::from([(String::from("API"), String::from("MYKEY"))]);
278:     /// let key = warp::crypto::generate::<32>();
279:     /// let tesseract = warp::tesseract::Tesseract::import(&key, map).unwrap();
280:     ///

282:     /// assert_eq!(tesseract.retrieve("API").unwrap(), String::from("MYKEY"))
283:     /// ```
284:     pub fn import(passphrase: &[u8], map: HashMap<String, String>) -> Result<Self> {
285:         let tesseract = Tesseract::default();
286:         tesseract.unlock(passphrase)?;
287:         for (key, val) in map {
288:             tesseract.set(key.as_str(), val.as_str())?;

293:     /// Decrypts and export tesseract contents to a `HashMap`
294:     ///
295:     /// # Example
296:     ///
297:     /// ```
298:     ///  let mut tesseract = warp::tesseract::Tesseract::default();
299:     ///  tesseract.unlock(&warp::crypto::generate::<32>()).unwrap();
300:     ///  tesseract.set("API", "MYKEY").unwrap();
301:     ///  
302:     ///  let map = tesseract.export().unwrap();
303:     ///  assert_eq!(map.contains_key("API"), true);
304:     ///  assert_eq!(map.get("API"), Some(&String::from("MYKEY")));
305:     /// ```
306:     pub fn export(&self) -> Result<HashMap<String, String>> {
307:         if !self.is_unlock() {
308:             return Err(Error::TesseractLocked);
309:         }
310:         let keys = self.internal_keys();
311:         let mut map = HashMap::new();
312:         for key in keys {
313:             let value = match self.retrieve(&key) {
314:                 Ok(v) => v,
315:                 Err(e) => match self.is_key_check_enabled() {
316:                     true => return Err(e),
317:                     false => continue,
318:                 },
319:             };
320:             map.insert(key.clone(), value);
321:         }
322:         Ok(map)
323:     }
324: }

412:     /// To store a value to be encrypted into the keystore. If the key already exist, it
413:     /// will be overwritten.

415:     /// # Example

417:     /// ```

419:     ///  tesseract.unlock(&warp::crypto::generate::<32>()).unwrap();
420:     ///  tesseract.set("API", "MYKEY").unwrap();

422:     /// ```
423:     pub fn set(&self, key: &str, value: &str) -> Result<()> {
424:         if !self.is_unlock() {
425:             return Err(Error::TesseractLocked);
426:         }
427:         let pkey = Cipher::self_decrypt(&self.enc_pass.read())?;
428:         let data = Cipher::direct_encrypt(value.as_bytes(), &pkey)?;
429:         self.internal.write().insert(key.to_string(), data);
430:         self.save()

448:     /// Used to retrieve and decrypt the value stored for the key
449:     ///
450:     /// # Example

452:     /// ```

454:     ///  tesseract.unlock(&warp::crypto::generate::<32>()).unwrap();
455:     ///  tesseract.set("API", "MYKEY").unwrap();
456:     ///  assert!(tesseract.exist("API"));
457:     ///  let val = tesseract.retrieve("API").unwrap();
458:     ///  assert_eq!(val, String::from("MYKEY"));
459:     /// ```
460:     pub fn retrieve(&self, key: &str) -> Result<String> {
461:         if !self.is_unlock() {
462:             return Err(Error::TesseractLocked);
463:         }
464: 
465:         if !self.exist(key) {
466:             return Err(Error::ObjectNotFound);
467:         }
468: 
469:         let pkey = Cipher::self_decrypt(&self.enc_pass.read())?;
470:         let data = self
471:             .internal
472:             .read()
473:             .get(key)
474:             .cloned()
475:             .ok_or(Error::ObjectNotFound)?;
476:         let slice = Cipher::direct_decrypt(&data, &pkey)?;
477:         let plain_text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&slice[..]).to_string();
478:         Ok(plain_text)
479:     }

481:     /// Used to update the passphrase to the keystore
482:     ///
483:     /// # Example
484:     ///
485:     /// ```
486:     ///  let mut tesseract = warp::tesseract::Tesseract::default();
487:     ///  tesseract.unlock(b"current_phrase").unwrap();
488:     ///  tesseract.set("API", "MYKEY").unwrap();
489:     ///  tesseract.update_unlock(b"current_phrase", b"new_phrase").unwrap();
490:     ///  let val = tesseract.retrieve("API").unwrap();
491:     ///  assert_eq!("MYKEY", val);
492:     /// ```
493:     pub fn update_unlock(&self, old_passphrase: &[u8], new_passphrase: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {
494:         if !self.is_unlock() {
495:             return Err(Error::TesseractLocked);
496:         }
497: 
498:         let pkey = Cipher::self_decrypt(&self.enc_pass.read())?;
499: 
500:         if old_passphrase != pkey || old_passphrase == new_passphrase || pkey == new_passphrase {
501:             return Err(Error::InvalidPassphrase); //TODO: Mismatch?
502:         }
503: 
504:         let exported = self.export()?;
505: 
506:         let mut encrypted = HashMap::new();
507: 
508:         for (key, val) in exported {
509:             let data = Cipher::direct_encrypt(val.as_bytes(), new_passphrase)?;
510:             encrypted.insert(key, data);
511:         }
512: 
513:         self.lock();
514:         *self.internal.write() = encrypted;
515:         self.unlock(new_passphrase)?;
516:         self.save()
517:     }

581:     /// ```

583:     ///  assert!(!tesseract.is_unlock());

587:     ///  tesseract.lock();
588:     ///  assert!(!tesseract.is_unlock())

591:         !self.enc_pass.read().is_empty()
592:             && self.unlock.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
593:             && !self.soft_unlock.load(Ordering::Relaxed)

602:     /// Store password in memory to be used to decrypt contents.
603:     ///
604:     /// # Example
605:     ///
606:     /// ```
607:     ///  let mut tesseract = warp::tesseract::Tesseract::default();
608:     ///  tesseract.unlock(&warp::crypto::generate::<32>()).unwrap();
609:     ///  assert!(tesseract.is_unlock());
610:     /// ```
611:     pub fn unlock(&self, passphrase: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {
612:         *self.enc_pass.write() = Cipher::self_encrypt(passphrase)?;
613:         self.soft_unlock.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
614:         if self.is_key_check_enabled() {
615:             let keys = self.internal_keys();
616:             for key in keys {
617:                 if let Err(e) = self.dry_retrieve(&key) {
618:                     self.lock();
619:                     return Err(e);
620:                 }
621:             }
622:         }
623:         self.soft_unlock.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
624:         self.unlock.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
625:         let _ = self.event_tx.try_broadcast(TesseractEvent::Unlocked);
626:         Ok(())
627:     }

637:     ///  tesseract.lock();
638:     ///  assert!(!tesseract.is_unlock());
639:     /// ```
640:     pub fn lock(&self) {
641:         if self.save().is_ok() {
642:             //
643:         }
644:         self.enc_pass.write().zeroize();
645:         self.unlock.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
646:         self.soft_unlock.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
647:         let _ = self.event_tx.try_broadcast(TesseractEvent::Locked);

652:     pub fn subscribe(&self) -> BoxStream<'static, TesseractEvent> {
653:         let mut rx = self.event_rx.clone();
654:         let stream = async_stream::stream! {
655:             loop {
656:                 match rx.recv().await {
657:                     Ok(event) => yield event,
658:                     Err(async_broadcast::RecvError::Closed) => break,
659:                     Err(_) => {}
660:                 };
661:             }
662:         };
663: 
664:         stream.boxed()
665:     }

698:             let value: Vec<u8> = LocalStorage::get(&key).unwrap();
699:             self.internal.write().insert(key, value);

113:     /// Create a `Directory` instance
114:     ///
115:     ///
116:     /// # Examples
117:     ///
118:     /// ```
119:     ///     use warp::constellation::{directory::Directory, item::{Item}};
120:     ///
121:     ///     let dir = Directory::new("Test Directory");
122:     ///     assert_eq!(dir.name(), String::from("Test Directory"));
123:     ///
124:     ///     let root = Directory::new("/root/test/test2");
125:     ///     assert_eq!(root.has_item("test"), true);
126:     ///     let test = root.get_item("test").and_then(|item| item.get_directory()).unwrap();
127:     ///     assert_eq!(test.has_item("test2"), true);
128:     /// ```
129:     pub fn new(name: &str) -> Self {
130:         let directory = Directory::default();
131:         // let name = name.trim();
132:         if name.is_empty() {
133:             return directory;
134:         }
135: 
136:         let mut path = name
137:             .split('/')
138:             .filter(|&s| !s.is_empty())
139:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
140: 
141:         // check to determine if the array is empty
142:         if path.is_empty() {
143:             return directory;
144:         }
145: 
146:         let mut name = path.remove(0);
147:         if name.len() > 256 {
148:             name = &name[..256];
149:         }
150: 
151:         *directory.name.write() = name.to_string();
152: 
153:         if !path.is_empty() {
154:             let sub = Self::new(path.join("/").as_str());
155:             if directory.add_item(sub).is_ok() {};
156:         }
157:         directory
158:     }

174:         self.get_items()

285:     ///         use warp::constellation::directory::{Directory};
286:     ///

293:     ///         root.add_item(sub2).unwrap();
294:     ///
295:     ///         assert_eq!(root.has_item("Sub Directory 1"), true);
296:     ///         assert_eq!(root.has_item("Sub Directory 2"), true);
297:     ///         assert_eq!(root.has_item("Sub Directory 3"), true);
298:     ///
299:     ///         root.move_item_to("Sub Directory 2", "Sub Directory 1").unwrap();
300:     ///         root.move_item_to("Sub Directory 3", "Sub Directory 1/Sub Directory 2").unwrap();
301:     ///
302:     ///         assert_ne!(root.has_item("Sub Directory 2"), true);
303:     ///         assert_ne!(root.has_item("Sub Directory 3"), true);
304:     ///
305:     ///         root.remove_item_from_path("/Sub Directory 1/Sub Directory 2", "Sub Directory 3").unwrap();
306:     ///
307:     ///         assert_eq!(root.get_item_by_path("Sub Directory 1/Sub Directory 2/Sub Directory 3").is_err(), true);
308:     /// ```
309:     pub fn remove_item_from_path(&self, directory: &str, item: &str) -> Result<Item, Error> {
310:         self.get_item_by_path(directory)?
311:             .get_directory()?
312:             .remove_item(item)

315:     /// Used to move the child to another `Directory`
316:     ///
317:     /// # Examples
318:     ///
319:     /// ```
320:     ///     use warp::constellation::{directory::Directory};
321:     ///
322:     ///     let mut root = Directory::new("Test Directory");
323:     ///     let sub0 = Directory::new("Sub Directory 1");
324:     ///     let sub1 = Directory::new("Sub Directory 2");
325:     ///     root.add_item(sub0).unwrap();
326:     ///     root.add_item(sub1).unwrap();
327:     ///
328:     ///     assert_eq!(root.has_item("Sub Directory 1"), true);
329:     ///     assert_eq!(root.has_item("Sub Directory 2"), true);
330:     ///
331:     ///     root.move_item_to("Sub Directory 2", "Sub Directory 1").unwrap();
332:     ///
333:     ///     assert_ne!(root.has_item("Sub Directory 2"), true);
334:     /// ```
335:     pub fn move_item_to(&self, child: &str, dst: &str) -> Result<(), Error> {
336:         let (child, dst) = (child.trim(), dst.trim());
337: 
338:         if self.get_item_by_path(dst)?.is_file() {
339:             return Err(Error::ItemNotDirectory);
340:         }
341: 
342:         if self.get_item_by_path(dst)?.get_directory()?.has_item(child) {
343:             return Err(Error::DuplicateName);
344:         }
345: 
346:         let item = self.remove_item(child)?;
347: 
348:         // If there is an error, place the item back into the current directory
349:         match self
350:             .get_item_by_path(dst)
351:             .and_then(|item| item.get_directory())
352:         {
353:             Ok(directory) => {
354:                 if let Err(e) = directory.add_item(item.clone()) {
355:                     self.add_item(item)?;
356:                     return Err(e);
357:                 }
358:             }
359:             Err(e) => {
360:                 self.add_item(item)?;
361:                 return Err(e);
362:             }
363:         }
364:         self.signal();
365:         Ok(())
366:     }
367: }

443:     /// ```

445:         for item in self.items.read().iter() {
446:             if item.name().eq(item_name) {
447:                 return Ok(item.clone());
448:             }
449:             if let Ok(directory) = item.get_directory() {
450:                 match directory.find_item(item_name) {

452:                     //Since we know the error will be `Error::ItemInvalid`, we can continue through the iteration until it ends

492:     ///     sub0.add_item(sub1).unwrap();
493:     ///     root.add_item(sub0).unwrap();
494:     ///
495:     ///     assert_eq!(root.get_item_by_path("/Sub Directory 1/").is_ok(), true);
496:     ///     assert_eq!(root.get_item_by_path("/Sub Directory 1/Sub Directory 2/").is_ok(), true);
497:     ///     assert_eq!(root.get_item_by_path("/Sub Directory 1/Sub Directory 2/Sub Directory 3").is_ok(), true);
498:     ///     assert_eq!(root.get_item_by_path("/Sub Directory 1/Sub Directory 2/Sub Directory3/Another Dir").is_ok(), false);
499:     /// ```
500:     pub fn get_item_by_path(&self, path: &str) -> Result<Item, Error> {
501:         let mut path = path
502:             .split('/')
503:             .filter(|&s| !s.is_empty())
504:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
505:         if path.is_empty() {
506:             return Err(Error::InvalidPath);
507:         }
508:         let name = path.remove(0);
509:         let item = self.get_item(name)?;
510:         return if !path.is_empty() {
511:             if let Ok(dir) = item.get_directory() {
512:                 dir.get_item_by_path(path.join("/").as_str())
513:             } else {
514:                 Ok(item)
515:             }
516:         } else {
517:             Ok(item)
518:         };
519:     }
520: }

610:         self.set_signal(signal.clone());

622:                     file.set_path(self.path())

191:         let data_stream = stream::once(async move { Ok::<_, std::io::Error>(data) }).boxed();
192: 
193:         let ipfs_path = self
194:             .ipfs
195:             .unixfs()
196:             .add(
197:                 data_stream,
198:                 Some(AddOption {
199:                     pin: true,
200:                     ..Default::default()
201:                 }),
202:             )
203:             .await?;
204: 
205:         tracing::trace!(path = %ipfs_path, "Index exported");
206: 
207:         let cid = ipfs_path
208:             .root()
209:             .cid()
210:             .ok_or(Error::OtherWithContext("unable to get cid".into()))?;
211: 
212:         let last_cid = self.index_cid.write().replace(*cid);
213: 
214:         if let Some(path) = self.config.path.as_ref() {
215:             if let Err(_e) = tokio::fs::write(path.join(".index_id"), cid.to_string()).await {
216:                 tracing::error!(cid = %cid, "Error writing index: {_e}");
217:             }
218:         }
219: 
220:         if let Some(last_cid) = last_cid {
221:             if *cid != last_cid {
222:                 if self.ipfs.is_pinned(&last_cid).await? {
223:                     tracing::trace!(cid = %last_cid, "Unpinning block");
224:                     self.ipfs.remove_pin(&last_cid).recursive().await?;
225:                     tracing::trace!(cid = %last_cid, "Block unpinned");
226:                 }
227: 
228:                 tracing::trace!(cid = %last_cid, "Removing block");
229:                 let b = self.ipfs.remove_block(last_cid, true).await?;
230:                 tracing::trace!(cid = %last_cid, amount_removed = b.len(), "Blocks removed");
231:             }
232:         }
233: 
234:         tracing::trace!(cid = %cid, "Index exported");
235:         Ok(())
236:     }
237: }

273:     pub async fn put(
274:         &mut self,
275:         name: &str,
276:         path: &str,
277:     ) -> Result<ConstellationProgressStream, Error> {
278:         let name = name.trim();
279:         if name.len() < 2 || name.len() > 256 {
280:             return Err(Error::InvalidLength {
281:                 context: "name".into(),
282:                 current: name.len(),
283:                 minimum: Some(2),
284:                 maximum: Some(256),
285:             });
286:         }
287: 
288:         let ipfs = self.ipfs.clone();
289: 
290:         let path = PathBuf::from(path);
291:         if !path.is_file() {
292:             return Err(Error::FileNotFound);
293:         }
294: 
295:         let file_size = tokio::fs::metadata(&path).await?.len();
296: 
297:         if self.current_size() + (file_size as usize) >= self.max_size() {
298:             return Err(Error::InvalidLength {
299:                 context: path
300:                     .file_name()
301:                     .and_then(OsStr::to_str)
302:                     .map(str::to_string)
303:                     .unwrap_or("path".to_string()),
304:                 current: self.current_size() + file_size as usize,
305:                 minimum: None,
306:                 maximum: Some(self.max_size()),
307:             });
308:         }
309: 
310:         let current_directory = self.current_directory()?;
311: 
312:         if current_directory.get_item_by_path(name).is_ok() {
313:             return Err(Error::FileExist);
314:         }
315: 
316:         let ((width, height), exact) = (
317:             self.config.thumbnail_size,
318:             self.config.thumbnail_exact_format,
319:         );
320: 
321:         let ticket = self
322:             .thumbnail_store
323:             .insert(&path, width, height, exact)
324:             .await?;
325: 
326:         let background = self.config.thumbnail_task;
327: 
328:         let name = name.to_string();
329:         let fs = self.clone();
330:         let guard = self.signal_guard.clone();
331: 
332:         let progress_stream = async_stream::stream! {
333: 
334:             let mut last_written = 0;
335: 
336:             let mut total_written = 0;
337:             let mut returned_path = None;
338: 
339:             let mut stream = ipfs.unixfs().add(path.clone(), Some(AddOption { pin: true, ..Default::default() }));
340: 
341:             while let Some(status) = stream.next().await {
342:                 let name = name.clone();
343:                 match status {
344:                     UnixfsStatus::CompletedStatus { path, written, total_size } => {
345:                         returned_path = Some(path);
346:                         total_written = written;
347:                         last_written = written;
348:                         yield Progression::CurrentProgress {
349:                             name,
350:                             current: written,
351:                             total: total_size,
352:                         };
353:                     }
354:                     UnixfsStatus::FailedStatus {
355:                         written, error, ..
356:                     } => {
357:                         last_written = written;
358:                         yield Progression::ProgressFailed {
359:                             name,
360:                             last_size: Some(last_written),
361:                             error: error.map(|e| e.to_string()),
362:                         };
363:                         return;
364:                     }
365:                     UnixfsStatus::ProgressStatus { written, total_size } => {
366:                         last_written = written;
367:                         yield Progression::CurrentProgress {
368:                             name,
369:                             current: written,
370:                             total: total_size,
371:                         };
372:                     }
373:                 }
374:             }
375:             let ipfs_path = match
376:                 returned_path {
377:                     Some(path) => path,
378:                     None => {
379:                         yield Progression::ProgressFailed {
380:                             name,
381:                             last_size: Some(last_written),
382:                             error: Some("IpfsPath not set".into()),
383:                         };
384:                         return;
385:                     }
386:                 };
387: 
388:             let file = warp::constellation::file::File::new(&name);
389:             file.set_size(total_written);
390:             file.set_reference(&format!("{ipfs_path}"));
391:             file.set_file_type(to_file_type(&name));
392: 
393:             if let Ok(Err(_e)) = tokio::task::spawn_blocking({
394:                 let f = file.clone();
395:                 move || f.hash_mut().hash_from_file(&path)
396:             }).await {}
397: 
398:             if let Err(e) = current_directory.add_item(file.clone()) {
399:                 yield Progression::ProgressFailed {
400:                     name,
401:                     last_size: Some(last_written),
402:                     error: Some(e.to_string()),
403:                 };
404:                 return;
405:             }
406: 
407:             let task = {
408:                 let fs = fs.clone();
409:                 let store = fs.thumbnail_store.clone();
410:                 let file = file.clone();
411:                 async move {
412:                     match store.get(ticket).await {
413:                         Ok((extension_type, thumbnail)) => {
414:                             file.set_thumbnail(&thumbnail);
415:                             file.set_thumbnail_format(extension_type.into());
416:                         }
417:                         Err(_e) => {}
418:                     }
419:                 }
420:             };
421: 
422:             if !background {
423:                 task.await;
424:             } else {
425:                 tokio::spawn(task);
426:             }
427: 
428:             let _guard = guard.write().await;
429: 
430:             yield Progression::ProgressComplete {
431:                 name: name.to_string(),
432:                 total: Some(total_written),
433:             };
434: 
435:             fs.constellation_tx.emit(ConstellationEventKind::Uploaded {
436:                 filename: name.to_string(),
437:                 size: Some(total_written)
438:             }).await;
439:         };
440: 
441:         Ok(ConstellationProgressStream(progress_stream.boxed()))
442:     }
